response_summary: Audited current marketplace transaction contract and implementation boundaries; confirmed non-executing approval/state helpers and documented package-manager, recovery, trust and audit blockers; revalidated response-log procedure.

Implemented optional catalog package-conflict metadata across schema and validator; made dependency-plan resolution reject conflicts declared by either selected package; added resolver and validator regression tests and documented the contract boundary.

Added fail-closed resolver exclusions for rejected, quarantined and revoked catalog review states and invalid or revoked signatures, with regression tests; pending/unverified metadata remains preview-only.
Hardened marketplace catalog release-version validation to enforce Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 prerelease/build identifier rules; added regression tests and documented the metadata boundary.

Aligned marketplace JSON Schema release-version validation with the Python SemVer 2.0.0 validator, restricted version digits to ASCII as required by SemVer, added regression coverage and documented validator/schema parity.

Aligned catalog JSON Schema package/publisher identifiers and optional URL constraints with the Python validator, added regression cases for invalid identifiers and non-HTTPS metadata URLs, and documented the parity.

Closed marketplace compatibility range schemas against unknown fields, aligned bounded non-blank text constraints with the Python validator, added regression cases for whitespace-only and oversized range values, and documented the parity.

Hardened catalog timestamps to explicit-timezone RFC3339 syntax with calendar validation and matching schema constraints; made malformed URL parsing fail closed; added timestamp and malformed-URL regression cases and documented the behavior.

Aligned the catalog schema's release-version maximum length with the Python validator's 128-character limit, added regressions for overlong versions and whitespace-only categories/tags, and corrected a documentation line break.

Expanded unified CI to execute the complete marketplace test suite, including catalog validation, dependency resolution and transaction lifecycle tests, instead of only the transaction-state test module.

Aligned all six marketplace JSON Schema HTTPS URL patterns with the Python validator by rejecting whitespace throughout authorities and paths while permitting percent-encoded spaces; added schema-pattern regression coverage and documented the rule.

Hardened resolver direct release parsing by reusing the catalog validator's strict ASCII SemVer grammar, changed compatibility/wildcard numeric parsing to ASCII digits, added direct-parser regression cases, and fixed a tab URL test fixture after CI exposed it was testing a literal backslash-t. The marketplace CI job passed on the corrected commit.

Expanded marketplace resolver conformance coverage with the SemVer 2.0.0 prerelease precedence sequence, inclusive/exclusive dependency-constraint operator cases, and malformed/empty constraint clauses; documented the additional guarantees. The complete unified CI workflow passed, including marketplace validation.

Hardened the shared dependency planner to reject malformed roots, non-mapping package graphs, text-valued dependency declarations, and invalid or unhashable dependency IDs through DependencyPlanError; added regression tests and documented the input contract. Unified CI was queued for the updated branch; no passing result is claimed yet.

Validated marketplace catalog-plan roots and dependency graph keys/values before resolution; malformed inputs now raise CatalogResolutionError. Added regression tests and documentation. Unified CI was still running; no passing result claimed.

Hardened catalog plan inputs so candidate collections and optional dependency-constraint mappings are validated before use; malformed inputs now raise CatalogResolutionError. Added regression coverage and documented the input contract. CI result not yet verified.

Replaced recursive dependency graph traversal with iterative depth-first ordering to support deep valid graphs without Python recursion-limit failures; retained deterministic dependency-first ordering and explicit cycle paths. Added deep-chain and cycle-path regression tests and documented the behavior. CI result not yet verified.

Hardened the shared dependency planner to validate the complete supplied graph before planning, including disconnected entries, package-ID keys, duplicate edges, malformed declarations and missing references; added regression tests and documented the whole-graph validation contract. CI result not yet available.

Hardened marketplace JSON Schema regex end anchors with an explicit end-of-input guard so final line terminators cannot bypass identifier, SemVer, digest, timestamp or HTTPS URL patterns; added regression coverage and documented the schema/Python full-string validation contract. Unified CI is pending; no passing result is claimed.

Hardened the shared dependency planner to reject mapping-shaped roots and dependency declarations instead of silently iterating mapping keys as package IDs; added regression tests and documented the stricter collection contract. Unified CI was pending at log time.

Hardened catalog URL validation to reject all Unicode Cc control characters, including DEL and C1 controls, before URL parsing; added malformed-URL regression cases and documented the expanded fail-closed rule. The previously observed unified-validation run was cancelled; no passing result is claimed for this change.
